# Raw notes — verbatim originals

Original bench notes for the electrode preps, **transcribed exactly as written** (typos, unit
slips and all). Kept as the ground-truth source for the cleaned logs one level up
(`../MMB1_*_Electrode_Prep.md`).

**Do not edit these** — if a value is wrong, fix it in the cleaned log and note it there; leave the
raw record intact.

| Raw file | Cleaned log |
|---|---|
| `MMB1-6A_Slurry_prep.md` | `../MMB1_6A_Electrode_Prep.md` |
| `MMB1-8A_Slurry_prep.md` | `../MMB1_8A_Electrode_Prep.md` |
| `MMB1-10A_Slurry_prep.md` | `../MMB1_10A_Electrode_Prep.md` |

Known slips already resolved in the cleaned logs:
- "200mL" pipette → **200 µL** (weight-confirmed: 0.195 g).
- 10A active material written "MMB1-6A" → **MMB1_10A** (copy-paste carryover).
- **"calendared" → "coated".** Habitual slip: in these notes "calendared" almost always means
  *coated*. Only the destroyed sample was ever actually calendered (see `../../Calendering_Notes.md`);
  6A / 8A / 10A here are coated and **still awaiting calendering**. So the thickness readings are
  **as-coated**, not post-calendering.
